parts.t: Welcome to Country Lane! This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom, 2-story home with a finished basement offers a bright spacious layout perfect for family living and entertaining. The sunlit kitchen boasts an island, breakfast bar, and ample cabinets. The master bedroom features a large ensuite with double sinks, a soaker tub, and a separate shower. The finished basement includes a cozy family room, a spacious fourth bedroom, and an oversized laundry room. Located in central Albion, it's within walking distance to transit, Albion Elementary, Samuel Robertson schools, parks, shopping, and more. Don’t miss this exceptional opportunity!
